pe_assessment: Vendor trailing17.38x is inflated-denominator cheapness: Q2 other income$97.983bn largely unrealised gains. Forward23.07x is a forecast, not verified recurring TTM. A buy rests on observed operating growth and cash capacity, not reported EPS$9.11.
margin_analysis: Q2 operating margin40.770/119.796=34.03%, versus32%; operating income+30%. Investment gains are below operating income and are excluded from the operating thesis.
debt_analysis: June cash/securities$242.474bn versus disclosed long-term debt$98.165bn (not all debt/lease obligations). Q2 CFO39.069 less capex44.924=-5.855bn FCF; H1FCF4.261bn, TTMFCF53.273bn. Equity capital raise49.6bn provides liquidity with dilution.
growth_outlook: Q2 revenue+24%, Cloud+82%, operating income+30%; this independent operating growth supports upside even after discarding exceptional net-income growth.
key_risks: AI capex and equity dilution are measurable costs; Q2 negative FCF cannot be dismissed as missing data.
Trailing P/E is distorted; preferred/common capital issuance and prospective ATM sales can dilute per-share return.
key_strengths: Operating margin expansion and Cloud profitability support the recurring business.
Large liquidity and positive TTM FCF reduce near-term funding stress despite quarterly cash deficit.
summary: Alphabet earns buy from rising operating profitability and balance-sheet capacity. Medium confidence reflects heavy reinvestment and dilution; unrealised gains are excluded from the return thesis.
